title: Mind Your Own Business
summary: A little boy keeps eating chocolate on a bus. A man tries to give him advice, but the boy gives him an unexpected and funny answer.

dialogues.english: A little boy was sitting on a crowded bus, happily eating chocolate.
dialogues.translation: Một cậu bé đang ngồi trên chiếc xe buýt đông người, vui vẻ ăn sô-cô-la.

dialogues.english: He finished one bar, then opened another one, and then another.
dialogues.translation: Cậu ăn hết một thanh, rồi mở thanh khác, rồi thêm một thanh nữa.

dialogues.english: An old man sitting next to him watched nervously for a while.
dialogues.translation: Một ông lão ngồi bên cạnh lo lắng nhìn cậu bé một lúc.

dialogues.english: Young man, do you know that too much chocolate can damage your teeth?
dialogues.translation: Cậu bé, cháu có biết rằng ăn quá nhiều sô-cô-la có thể làm hỏng răng không?

dialogues.english: My grandfather lived to be 102 years old.
dialogues.translation: Ông của cháu đã sống tới 102 tuổi.

dialogues.english: Really? Was it because he ate a lot of chocolate?
dialogues.translation: Thật sao? Có phải vì ông ấy ăn nhiều sô-cô-la không?

dialogues.english: It was because he was always minding his own business.
dialogues.translation: Đó là vì ông ấy luôn lo chuyện của mình.

dialogues.english: Suddenly, the whole bus became very quiet.
dialogues.translation: Đột nhiên, cả chiếc xe buýt trở nên im lặng.

vocabulary.example: The bus is very crowded in the morning.
Too much sugar can damage your teeth.
He told me to mind my own business.

quiz.question: Why did the boy say his grandfather lived a long life?
options: Because he ate chocolate every day
Because he minded his own business
Because he never took the bus
quiz.answer: Because he minded his own business
